title: Nick Bostrom on What Happens If AI Solves All Problems
title_cn: 尼克·博斯特罗姆谈如果人工智能解决所有问题会发生什么
summary: The philosopher Nick Bostrom was one of the first thinkers who mapped out the existential risk of AI. In his 2014 book, Superintelligence: Paths, Dangers, Strategies he delved into scenarios — like the “paperclip maximizer” for instance — that showed the dangers that unfettered and highly intelligent AI posed to humans. A decade later, in Deep Utopia: Life and Meaning in a Solved World, he looked at the other side of the AI coin, and theorizes what human experience might look like if AI is capable of solving all of our problems. What happens if AI and robots can literally do every single thing better than humans can? How would we find any meaning or satisfaction from life? On this episode, he speaks to us about the two divergent ways of understanding AI's future, what we might do, and what we can do right now to improve the chances that AI actually improves our lives. title_cn: 巴基斯坦强烈谴责美国特使有关克什米尔争议地区的言论
summary: Pakistan condemned a statement by the American ambassador in New Delhi that referred to a disputed territory as an “important part of India,” underscoring tensions between the nations over Jammu and Kashmir.
